name: Apprentice's Duties
summary: James Halloran needs giant crocolisk hides after his apprentice is mauled in the marshes. The tanner in Menethil Harbor asks travelers to finish the dangerous harvest.

sections.title: A Harsh Apprenticeship
sections.body: James Halloran sent his young apprentice into the Wetlands marshes to skin giant crocolisks. When the boy did not return, Halloran searched for him and found him badly mauled by the beasts. Menethil Harbor's tradesmen depend on materials from the surrounding country, where the bogs make such work dangerous.

sections.title: Skins and Retribution
sections.body: The town midwife believes Halloran's apprentice will survive, though the attack cost him a leg. Halloran needs hides for his trade and wants vengeance on the beasts that tore into the boy he loves like a son. He asks travelers to go north along the coast, past the murloc hovels, and hunt the giant crocolisks.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a leatherworker and tanner in Menethil Harbor. He depends on hides gathered from Wetlands wildlife to keep his craft going.
Halloran sent his apprentice into the marsh to gather giant crocolisk hides. The beasts mauled the boy and took his leg, but the town midwife expects him to survive.

faq.q: Where are the giant crocolisks located?
faq.answer: Giant crocolisks prowl the Wetlands marshes and northern coast, beyond the coastal murloc settlements north of Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: What prerequisite quest leads to this task?
faq.answer: Before this, Halloran asked travelers to hunt smaller crocolisks in 'Young Crocolisk Skins.' Now he asks them to hunt the giant variety that wounded his apprentice.

faq.q: Why does Halloran still want the skins after the tragedy?
faq.answer: Halloran needs hides to keep his trade supplied, and he is angry at the beasts that maimed the boy he loves like a son. He welcomes a traveler willing to hunt and kill them.

faq.q: Does Halloran offer you an apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Halloran briefly jokes about taking you on as his new apprentice after seeing your work, then dismisses the idea. You are far too old, he says, and clearly bound for a different destiny.

angles.text: Menethil Harbor links Khaz Modan with the rest of the Alliance. The port depends on the safety and self-sufficiency of its local craftsmen.
Giant crocolisks are formidable marsh predators. Tracking them tests your skill at finding your way through murky waters and aggressive wildlife.
